subject: Mutual action plan draft + stakeholder/security checklist
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Charlotte Brooks <charlotte.brooks@macrotech.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan draft + stakeholder/security checklist

Hi Charlotte,

Thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. High-level recap and suggested next steps below so we can align on the path to a pilot/POC. I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP-v0.2.xlsx) and a short SOC2 evidence request we typically hand to security teams.

Quick summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: model-powered content personalization for product w/ latency <150ms on user-facing endpoints.
- Target POC window: 3–6 weeks once procurement/legal are aligned.
- Key decision criteria: latency, data residency, auditability (trace logs), and unit cost.

Proposed stakeholder map (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Evan Li (confirmed on call?)
- Security/compliance reviewer: your security lead (you mentioned someone on the security team)
- Procurement/contract: TBD (procurement lead to own SOW & terms)
- Implementation lead: Charlotte / Product team (POC owner)

Suggested MAP milestones (in MAP-v0.2):
1) Kickoff & requirements finalization — target: 2027-06-21
2) Security & legal signoff (evidence exchange) — target: 2027-06-28
3) Environment provisioning (dedicated test capacity) — target: 2027-07-05
4) POC execution (2 weeks) — target: 2027-07-05 to 2027-07-19
5) Business review & next steps — target: 2027-07-26

Asks:
- Please confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (names & emails).
- Can you confirm whether SOC2 Type II artifacts are sufficient or if you need additional controls evidence?
- Once we have the procurement contact, we’ll assign our contract lead and produce a procurement checklist for your team.

Attachments: MAP-v0.2.xlsx (mutual action plan spreadsheet), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (list of common docs/security artifacts).

If this looks right I’ll loop in Sean and Neha to draft the MAP timeline and start assembling the SOC2 bundle.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0126
From: Charlotte Brooks <charlotte.brooks@macrotech.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@macrotech.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft + stakeholder/security checklist

Thanks Ava — good demo and appreciate the clarity. A few quick notes and confirmations from our side: 

- Economic buyer: confirming Evan Li (cc'd) will own the final budget sign-off.
- Procurement lead: Priya Shah (procurement) will own contracts and SOW; I will loop her into procurement conversations. Priya's email is priya.shah@macrotech.ai.
- Security: our security reviewer is Michael Torres (not cc'd on this thread yet). Michael will need the SOC2 artifacts and a short threat-model note.

Timeline: We are hopeful to start the POC in early July. Can we target provisioning by 2027-07-05 and a two-week POC window? That aligns with Evan's availability and our product sprint.

On artifacts: SOC2 Type II plus the network diagram and data flow explanation should be fine to start. If Michael requests anything else we'll let you know. Please share the SOC2-evidence-request.pdf to him once you have the MAP updated.

Next steps from my side: I will introduce Priya and Michael on a separate email (procurement/security kick-off) by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
Charlotte Brooks
Director of Product, MacroTech
charlotte.brooks@macrotech.ai
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Charlotte Brooks <charlotte.brooks@macrotech.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan draft + stakeholder/security checklist — action items

Folks — forwarding Charlotte's confirmation. Action items for our side to keep momentum: 

1) Sean: can you update the MAP spreadsheet to add the procurement contact (Priya) and the revised milestone dates Charlotte proposed (provisioning by 2027-07-05)? Please also add an explicit acceptance criteria row for latency and audit logs.
2) Neha: please prepare the SOC2 artifact package plus a one-page data-flow/network diagram we can hand to Michael. Include where logs are stored, retention, and encryption-at-rest details.
3) I will draft a short procurement checklist (terms we expect: data residency, liability/caps, SLA targets) and be point for introductions to Priya.

I'll run through the MAP and share an updated XLS by tomorrow EOD. Keep the language tight — procurement teams hate ambiguity.

Thanks — Ava

Hi Charlotte / Ava,

Attached is MAP-v0.3.xlsx — I incorporated the provisioning target of 2027-07-05 and added an acceptance criteria section. Key highlights: 

- Kickoff: 2027-06-21 (requirements + success criteria) — owner: Charlotte
- Security review completed (evidence exchange): 2027-06-28 — owner: Neha (Redwood) & Michael (MacroTech)
- Provisioning & environment ready: 2027-07-05 — owner: Redwood infra team

- Business review & decision: 2027-07-26 — owner: Evan

Attachments included: MAP-v0.3.xlsx (updated milestones), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (unchanged).

Charlotte — once Priya is on the thread can you share any internal procurement form or PO process we should align to? We can prep a simple SOW and estimated costs for Evan to review. If you prefer, I can draft a short SOW skeleton and send to Priya.
